linkedin:
Only 22% of remote job listings show their pay.

Our analysis of 4,269 active USD remote listings found 939 (22%) that disclose a salary figure; 78% stay silent on pay. For Indonesian job seekers chasing USD roles, that silence matters when you negotiate.

The good news: 64% of listings (2,725) are open to applicants anywhere in the world. And when pay is disclosed, the top end is clear - OpenAI lists a Data Scientist at USD 293,000-325,000/yr and Equinix a Chief of Staff at USD 195,000-319,000/yr.

Skill demand: AI appears in 12% of listings; communication in 39%. 1,205 listings were posted in the last 7 days, so the market moves fast.

Our take: don't chase average USD pay. Target the transparent 22% where the range is explicit.
